sloka: भवान् कलत्रम् अस्माकम् स्वामि भावे व्यवस्थितः ।स्वामी कलत्रम् सैन्यस्य गतिः एषा परंतप ॥४-६५-२३॥
transliteration: bhavān kalatram asmākam svāmi bhāve vyavasthitaḥ ।svāmī kalatram sainyasya gatiḥ eṣā paraṁtapa ॥4-65-23॥

translations.english: 'O scorcher of enemies, you are established as the commander of the army and it is proper for us to protect you as we protect our wives.
